liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **encore cheers**: back after 133 archived shows (1030 days); rare: 10 archived performances [14]

## The recordings

- **Ween2002-06-23.mix.flacf** (recommended): soundboard; 21 songs; 99 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]. Said about its sound: Soundboard mix praised as very clear, capturing music and crowd sound powerfully [13]
- **ween2002-06-23.akg.flac16**: audience recording; 20 songs; 99 min [2]
- **ween2002-06-23.mbho.flac16**: source not stated; 20 songs; 98 min; rated 4/5 by 5 [3]. Said about its sound: Stream sounds muddy with noticeable pitch-shifting, especially during Roses Are Free and Voodoo Lady; Reviewer says the poor sound complaint likely reflects the low-fi stream; hi-fi version is fine, with many tapers at the festival; Reviewer considers it a very poor recording, with a phase-shifting, bathroom-like mic sound [10][11][12]
- **ween2002-06-23.fob.km184.shnf**: source not stated; 20 songs; 99 min [4]

## Tapers and lineage

- **Ween2002-06-23.mix.flacf**: transferred by CPS; source: SBD + unknown Audio Technica mic => Multiset > unknown laptop [1]. Also: Soundboard plus an unknown Audio Technica mic, via Multiset to an unknown laptop; DAT third generation, converted to WAV then FLAC; Transferred with a Tascam DA-20mkII and M-Audio Audiophile 2496 using Sound Forge and CD Wave [1]
- **ween2002-06-23.akg.flac16**: taped by Unknown; transferred by Unknown; source: Audience [2]. Also: Parts of Zoloft, The Mollusk and the encore break plus start of Buenos Tardes Amigo were patched from an MBHO 603a/KA500 source [2]
- **ween2002-06-23.mbho.flac16**: taped by Eric Foelske; transferred by Eric Foelske; source: MBHO 603a/KA500 > V2 > mod.SBM-1 > M1 (TS-DFC) [3]
- **ween2002-06-23.fob.km184.shnf**: taped by Jeff Killion; transferred by Jeff Killion; source: FOB Neumann KM184 (against center rail, ortf) > AETA PSP-3 > GP ADC-20 > DA-P1 [4]
